verdict.rationale: Filee's per-file-type presets bundle a conversion with optimization settings (quality, resizing, metadata, background removal) and can merge outputs into one PDF or ZIP. Watch folders apply conversion automatically to files that land in a folder and can move the originals aside, and the CLI can run presets. Multi-step format routes are found automatically, but nothing documents a user-defined pipeline of arbitrary ordered steps. missing for 10: an explicit user-composable chain of convert → optimize → deliver steps, delivery/output-destination actions beyond moving originals or merging, confirmation that watch folders run full presets, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can chain steps (convert, then optimize, then deliver) into one job or watched workflow

citations.quote: Presets per file type: quality, resizing, rotate and flip, DPI, grayscale, metadata, background removal, Trace to SVG
presets can merge everything into one PDF or one ZIP
Watch folders automatically convert the files that land in a folder and can move the originals aside.
Routes with several steps (HWP → HWPX → DOCX) are found automatically.
"filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
